2 Open the docs
Use Addins -> Docs, or from the console:
rsdocs::rsdocs()       # open in the viewer pane
rsdocs::rsdocs_stop()  # stop the docs server

title: Welcome
text: This documentation ships inside the rsdocs R package and is opened from the RStudio Addins menu.

title: Welcome
text:
2 How it is served
The site is rendered once at build time and copied to inst/docs/. The addin starts a small local web server and RStudio Server proxies it to your browser.
